connect_timeout_finding.explanation: reqwest connect_timeout covers name resolution. This network's stub resolver never answers AAAA for the deployment hostname (dig AAAA times out 3x); getaddrinfo waits ~6.2s then proceeds with the A record. openrouter.ai answers AAAA in 11ms (0.08s total), so the settled path is unaffected. curl is unaffected because it does not wait for AAAA.
connect_timeout_finding.result: kind=elastic cannot connect from this network: every attempt dies in DNS before the 5s connect timeout. The recall tier survived the same stall only because timeout_ms=20000 covers it (T0.6). A long-lived serve would still pay ~6s+ at startup and every fresh connection.

isolation: vanilla reqwest 0.12.28 + rustls (same versions as Lambo 0.10.0) GET / fails in 5.0s with Connect TimedOut; curl and OpenSSL succeed in under 1s. The failure is the DNS stall plus the 5s connect timeout, not TLS, not the endpoint, not auth.
re_embed_path: not exercised live: re-embed embeds every concept through the NEW embedder, so it is blocked by the same DNS/connect wall on this network. Command and semantics from 0.10.0 --help and docs: stop the serve holding the session, then `lambo re-embed --session <s> --agent <a>` with the elastic [embedder] configured; every concept is embedded BEFORE the graph is touched and the vector rewrite plus contract swap flush as one transaction with the lease release. Refuses --allow-embedding-mismatch (the migration IS the relabel). --missing-only backfills NULL vectors without touching the contract; --drop-image-vectors nulls image vectors instead of refusing.
